_comment: A bandit drummer's shield aura: reapplies a damage-absorbing shield of 15 HP plus 4 per level to every ally within 4.0 units every 30 ticks. A shield buff's lifetime equals its tick interval plus one, so it fades once the drummer dies or an ally leaves range. Does not shield the drummer itself, keeping it a priority target. All values placeholder.
name: RallyDrum
